Reverted the task#14 `disabled` flag. Disabling cameraserver made system_server's UsbCameraDeviceManagerObserver$BootCompletedReceiver block the MAIN thread in Camera.getNumberOfCameras -> BpServiceManager::getService(media.camera) usleep-spin (service never published) -> Watchdog killed system_server -> recurring soft reboot (dropbox system_server_watchdog x4: 11:22/11:26/11:30/11:38, all identical camera stack). cameraserver runs fine on this camera-less hardware (init.svc.cameraserver=running, media.camera found, 0 cameras), so class-main auto-start makes the service ready before BOOT_COMPLETED. incidentd/mediametrics/statsd remain disabled. Cost ~5.3M PSS, far less than the watchdog loop.
